description: A white plastic base with several upright rectangular posts sits on a green tabletop near a wall, with a loose rectangular post segment on the left side of the base. The left hand reaches to the leftmost upright post, grips it as a left-hand object, lifts it straight up to detach it from the base while the right hand stays on the base as a right-hand object, then the left hand moves left and sets the removed post piece down on the tabletop and releases it.
